fields.description: Issue includes local columns and commentary by Sam Marley, including a piece welcoming American Legion visitors to Miami and notes on Miami-area nightlife and businesses. Contains a feature on “old-timers” and what they are doing, mentions of Florida political activity including a possible 1936 gubernatorial candidacy and discussion of gambling, and extensive horse-racing content and tips. Includes radio program schedules and a letter to the editor about rising rents and housing costs in Miami.
